data.title: Cambodian opposition figure's daughter appointed PM's envoy in rare concession
data.description: PHNOM PENH — ⁠The ⁠daughter of a recently pardoned ​Cambodian opposition figure who was jailed for alleged treason has been ​appointed special envoy to Prime ‌Minister Hun Manet, a royal decree showed on Monday, in a rare concession to the political opposition.

data.title: Thailand to 'stay neutral' in US-China AI race
data.description: Thailand would maintain its neutral position between the United States and China and resist pressure to choose sides in the global race for artificial intelligence (AI), Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Monday.

data.title: PM denies staging stop in Buri Ram
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has denied suggestions that a police inspection of his vehicle in Buri Ram was staged, saying officers were simply performing their duties at a routine checkpoint.

data.title: Jeeno Thitikul wins in Portland as Thai golfers take top 3 spots
data.description: PORTLAND — Jeeno Thitikul closed ​with an 8-under-par 64 ⁠on Sunday to ⁠capture the Standard Portland Classic by ​one stroke at Columbia Edgewater Country Club in Portland, Oregon.

data.title: Taiwan's leader says government to propose record defence spending for 2027
data.description: TAIPEI - Taiwan's government will propose record defence spending for 2027, President Lai Ching-te said on Monday, as the island democracy faces growing military pressure from China.

data.title: Blue Bottle Coffee to open near Bangkok’s top parks
data.description: Bangkok is waking up earlier than ever. Well before the city traffic builds and office towers fill, Lumpini, Benjasiri and Benjakitti parks are already busy, with runners, walkers and fitness groups - many of whom finish their morning routine with one thing still to tick off - coffee.

data.title: Marine agency AI art contest sparks backlash
data.description: Strong criticisms were lobbed at the Department of Marine and Coastal Resources after it announced the results of an AI art contest held to mark National Dugong Conservation Day on Monday, with the winning image showing a dugong with what appeared to be four legs.

data.title: Ebola outbreak now DR Congo's deadliest ever
data.description: KINSHASA - A fast-spreading Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has become the country's deadliest ever after government figures showed it killed more than 2,300 people in three months.

data.title: Thai SEC expands checks on major shareholder funding
data.description: Thailand’s SEC has widened major-shareholder checks to significant funders, giving existing securities and digital asset firms 90 days to comply.

data.title: Fake tax invoice gang busted, 3 arrests
data.description: Economic crimes police have arrested three people allegedly involved a network that issued and sold fake tax invoices, costing the state 360 million baht in lost revenue, the Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) announced on Monday.

data.title: Former Thai national swimmer found dead on Saraburi canal-side
data.description: A former Thai national swimmer who had been missing for two days was found dead in a wooded area beside an irrigation canal in Saraburi province on Sunday.

data.title: 15th Thai soldier maimed by landmine along Cambodian border
data.description: UBON RATCHATHANI - A Thai soldier lost his leg when he stepped on a landmine during mine clearance on Monday in this northeastern province bordering Cambodia.

data.title: Proxy companies probe expands into Northeast
data.description: The Interior Ministry has expanded its investigation into foreign-owned proxy companies to Sakon Nakhon, while a senior Phuket official has proposed the government stop providing welfare benefits for foreign workers who give birth at public hospitals.

data.title: Rain brings respite as Belgium wrestles massive wildfire
data.description: ROBERTVILLE (BELGIUM) — Much-needed rain brought some respite Monday to firefighters on their fourth day battling Belgium's worst wildfire in a century, which has scorched vast expanses of nature reserve on the German border.

data.title: Jinny Lu, the world’s ugliest dog, proves that looks aren’t everything
data.description: NEW YORK — Ugly is subjective. But in this competition, it means everything.

data.title: Actress Hayden Panettiere dead at 36
data.description: Hayden Panettiere, the American actress known for her roles in the popular television series Heroes and Nashville, has died at the age of 36, according to media reports.

data.title: Nene Royal wows Phuket ahead of America’s Got Talent performance
data.description: PHUKET — Young Thai rocker Rattikarn Amloy, known as Nene Royal, and her band Ozone performed at the market where they had formerly busked on Sunday night, ahead of her trip to the United States to compete in the Live Shows round of America’s Got Talent ( AGT ).

data.title: Thai gold traders to oppose possible tax in talks with Finance Ministry
data.description: Thailand’s Gold Traders Association plans to oppose a possible gold tax while seeking support for US dollar trading and regional gold-hub ambitions.

data.title: Local man arrested for theft of fighting cocks, farm produce
data.description: BURIRAM - Police have arrested a 29-year-old man following a series of thefts targeting fighting cocks, farm produce and household goods in Chaloem Phra Kiat district.

data.title: Huawei Launches FusionSolar 9.0: First Grid-Forming PV Inverter for Thailand’s AI Era
data.description: Bangkok, 13 Aug 2026 — At the Huawei Digital Power Summit held under the theme “Energy, the Foundation of AI,” Huawei officially launched FusionSolar 9.0 — the world’s first Smart String Grid-Forming PV Inverter. The landmark event gathered over 700 policymakers, industry leaders, and energy experts to explore how next-generation grid-forming technologies can accelerate Thailand’s renewable energy transition while supporting the heavy power demands of AI data centres (AIDCs) and EV charging infrastructure.

data.title: Australia's mushroom murderer appeals conviction
data.description: SYDNEY - Australian toxic mushroom killer Erin Patterson launches an appeal Wednesday against her conviction in a triple-murder case that made headlines worldwide.

data.title: The Speak Easy
data.description: Late Checkout is housed in a 1970s textile mill in Mumbai, India. It offers European flavours, Japanese techniques and a menu built on balance. Old meets new is the cocktail game, crafted by Nikhil Rathod, who leads the beverage programme at Late Checkout.

data.title: Is this cave in Turkey where Homer wrote 'The Odyssey'?
data.description: BORNOVA (TURKEY) - On a Turkish hillside overlooking the olive-covered slopes outside Izmir is a cave known to generations of locals as the place where Homer penned "The Odyssey".

data.title: “Routes to Roots” Wins Creative Data Award at CEA 2026
data.description: As Thailand's tourism landscape continues to evolve, data from the Ministry of Tourism and Sports showd that tourist numbers have declined by 3.05% from the same period last year. Thailand's challenge may therefore no longer be simply, "How can we attract more tourists to Thailand?" but rather, "How can every journey by both Thai and international travellers create greater value?" The goal is to drive equitable tourism by distributing economic opportunities to communities, creating local value more broadly and inclusively, and enabling sustainable growth.

data.title: Couple and 30 cats die in Nonthaburi housefire
data.description: NONTHABURI - A couple and about 30 pet cats died in a house fire in the early hours of Monday and rescuers later found a charcoal stove and petrol container in the bedroom.

data.title: Axe hangs over Australian batters after Darwin 'disaster'
data.description: DARWIN, Australia - Australia's humiliating nine-wicket loss to Bangladesh has accelerated calls for regeneration of its ageing Test team with opener Jake Weatherald and the inconsistent Marnus Labuschagne in the firing line.

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri predicts ‘biggest year in history’ as 2027 expansion takes shape
data.description: ONE Championship chairman and CEO Chatri Sityodtong has predicted 2027 will be the biggest year in the promotion’s history, promising more major events in Qatar and teasing further international expansion.

data.title: Winning back walls from gangs, artists fill El Salvador's towns with colour
data.description: CONCEPCION DE ATACO (EL SALVADOR) - On the walls where gang members in El Salvador once marked their turf, urban artists are now creating large murals in a traveling festival that fills the streets of the Central American country with colour.

data.title: ONE Championship: Stella Hemetsberger ‘feeling good in the gold’ as kickboxing defence beckons
data.description: Stella Hemetsberger suggested a defence of her ONE Championship strawweight kickboxing title will “probably” come next after stopping Natalia Diachkova in Bangkok.

data.title: THAI, VitalLife and Bumrungrad Partner on Wellness-Focused In-Flight Entertainment
data.description: Thai Airways International Public Co Ltd (THAI), VitalLife Scientific Wellness Center, and Bumrungrad International Hospital have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to collaborate on the development of a new generation of in-flight entertainment (IFE) content that integrates travel, lifestyle and health knowledge. The initiative aims to enhance the onboard experience by inspiring passengers to embrace healthier lifestyles while showcasing Thailand’s unique destinations through a fresh wellness perspective.

data.title: Photos, memories all that remain for Colombia's bereaved after quake
data.description: CALI (COLOMBIA) - In Torres del Limonar, a Cali residential complex that collapsed in Monday's earthquake, people pick through rubble to recover victims' belongings and return them to grieving families.

data.title: Sabbath cafe clash lays bare Israel faultlines
data.description: JERUSALEM - Alma Ronen has been fighting in the Israeli military nearly constantly for more than two years. Spending her Saturday not in uniform but in a T-shirt and jeans, she would like to enjoy a coffee outside -- and resents that her more religious compatriots think otherwise.

data.title: As machinery removes rubble, hopes for survivors from Colombian quake dwindle
data.description: CALI (COLOMBIA) - The noise of backhoes, cranes and bulldozers echoed across Colombia's quake-hit cities on Sunday as workers labored to remove rubble, though the chance of finding survivors was slim a week after the disaster.
